reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread. The figure to put in the tracker is 185 seats now, going to 230 from January 1, 2027. The signed paperwork doesn't support 261.

- **2026 renewal:** the Renewal Order Form was signed March 20, 2026 and took effect April 1, 2026. It doesn't change the seat count.
- **Current count:** 185 seats, set by Amendment No. 1 from September 1, 2025. The Quarrendon account page also shows 185 active seats.
- **From January:** Amendment No. 3, signed September 22, 2026, raises it to 230 seats from January 1, 2027. The renewal date is March 31, 2027.

The 261 figure came from Ilse's October 14 message in this channel. I acknowledged it at the time without checking, which I shouldn't have done. I can't find 261 in any contract or amendment, so I asked Ilse in the thread to point to the document if a newer one exists.

I only gave seat counts and dates in the channel. I left out the prices and discounts that are also in those contracts.
